key_evidence_spans: A CT scan of the spine showed a mixed sclerotic and lytic lesion in the T12 vertebral body
CT-guided biopsy of a pulmonary nodule demonstrated a malignant neoplasm composed of spindle cells
Immunohistochemical staining of the tumor cells was positive for Bcl-2, vimentin, EMA, CD56, CD99, and TLE-1
CT scan of the chest revealed multiple bilateral pulmonary nodules and mediastinal and hilar lymphadenopathy concerning for metastatic disease
lower back pain radiating to both groins for 2 months
routine laboratory studies were within normal limits
Immunohistochemical staining of the tumor cells was negative for CD34, CD10, p63, cytokeratin, S100, desmin, and synaptophysin
